articles.summary: Strong operational execution results in twelfth consecutive quarter of year-over-year revenue and net income growth Electromed, Inc. (“Electromed”) (NYSE American: ELMD), a leader in innovative airway clearance technologies, today announced financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2025 (“Q1 FY 2026”). Q1 FY 2026 Company Highlights Net revenues increased 15.1% to $16.9 million in Q1 FY 2026, from $14.7 million in the first quarter of the prior fiscal year. Operating income increased to $2.7 million, a 37.8% increase from the first quarter of the prior fiscal year. Net income was $2.1 million, or $0.25 per diluted share, representing an increase of 44.9%, compared to $1.5 million, or $0.16 per diluted share in the first quarter of the prior fiscal year.
